query:
SELECT b.id, b.mentorId, b.studentId, u.id as mentorUserId, u.name as mentorName, s.id as studentUserId, s.name as studentName
FROM bookings b
JOIN users u ON u.name = '이윤호'
LEFT JOIN users s ON b.studentId = s.id;
